Web design Fort Lauderdale FL owners can rely on starts with how their customers search. A yacht owner at a slip on the New River does not type "boat services." They type the problem: bottom paint, a canvas enclosure, a generator that will not start, a detail before guests arrive. The marine trades along these canals live on those searches, and so do the plumbers, groomers and cafes that serve everyone else in Broward County.

Dominion Web Design Pro is Maurice Johnson. He writes every page himself, shows you a free demo before you spend anything, and charges one printed price. This page explains how he would plan a site for a Fort Lauderdale business, starting with the trade the city is known for.

The boating economy behind Fort Lauderdale website design

The city's official seal carries the nickname "Venice of America," and the waterways earn it: about 165 miles of them run inside city limits, part of roughly 300 miles of inland waterways across Greater Fort Lauderdale. The Intracoastal Waterway, the New River and a web of residential canals mean many homes come with a dock, and many docks come with a boat that needs work.

  • $9 billionEconomic impact of the marine industry in Broward County, according to the Marine Industries Association of South Florida as cited by the Greater Fort Lauderdale Alliance.
  • 111,000 jobsMarine industry jobs in Broward alone, out of more than 142,000 across the region, by the same count.
  • About 184,000 residentsThe city's population in the Census Bureau's July 2023 estimate, up from 182,760 in the 2020 count.

Brokers and yacht sales firms like to call the city the yachting capital of the world. Whatever you think of the title, the trade behind it is made of small operators: mobile mechanics, detailers, canvas and upholstery shops, varnish crews, delivery captains, brokers and the yards that haul boats out. Most of them get work by referral, and most of them are checked online before the phone rings.

What each marine trade's pages should say

A boat owner hiring help wants the same three answers from every trade: can you do this job, on a boat like mine, where it sits. Here is how that plays out by trade.

TradeWhat the owner typesWhat the page must show
Marine mechanicThe engine brand or the symptom, plus "near me"Engines and drives you work on, mobile or yard, the marinas and canals you will travel to, how fast you can come out
DetailerWash, wax, teak or interior, often with a boat lengthA plain list of services, the boat sizes you handle, photos of real work, recurring schedules for owners who are away
Canvas and upholsteryBimini, enclosure, cushions, coversMaterials you use, whether you measure on site, typical lead time, a quote form that asks for boat make and length
Captain or crewDelivery captain, day captain, licensed captainThe license and experience you can document, the routes you run, how to book and what you charge or how you quote
BrokerBoats for sale by size or builderYour listings or a clear path to them, the kind of boats you specialize in, and how a seller starts a listing with you

Notice that none of these needs a fancy site. They need the right words on the page, in the order a boat owner reads them.

Boat show week, walked through

The Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show is the city's biggest yearly test for these businesses. The 2025 show ran October 29 through November 2 across seven sites: the Broward County Convention Center, Bahia Mar Yachting Center, Hall of Fame Marina, Las Olas Marina, the 17th Street Yacht Basin, Pier Sixty-Six North and a superyacht area at Pier Sixty-Six South. WLRN reported the show's backers put its economic impact at nearly $1.8 billion.

Take a typical case, a made-up one to show the idea: a two-person mobile detailing crew. In the weeks before the show, exhibitors and private owners want boats turned out spotless. In the days after, visitors who met the crew on a dock look them up by name. The site needs a short notice at the top about show-week availability, a quote form that asks for the slip location and boat length, and a page for each kind of detail they do. When the show ends, the notice comes down and the regular pages carry on.

That change takes a few minutes if someone is looking after the site. On our hosting plan, that someone is us, at no extra charge per edit.

Web design in Fort Lauderdale that names the dock and the waterway

Google says it ranks local results on relevance, distance and prominence. For a business that comes to the customer, distance is measured against the service area you state, so the words on your site do real work. A mechanic who writes that he covers the New River, the 17th Street area and the Intracoastal from Las Olas north gives Google something to match when an owner searches from one of those spots.

The same idea helps a land-based shop. A florist, a cafe or a pet groomer near Las Olas Boulevard gets found by people standing a few blocks away, if the site says where the shop is in words people use and the hours are right.

Broward is more than one city

Many customers who search "web design fort lauderdale" or "website design fort lauderdale" actually run a business in one of Broward's other cities and towns, and their own customers search by those names. A landscaper in Plantation, a contractor in Davie, a salon in Wilton Manors, a restaurant in Hollywood or a repair shop in Oakland Park or Pompano Beach each has neighbors who type the town, not the county.

Pro includes ten city pages, each one researched and written about that place rather than copied with the town name swapped. For a service business covering much of the county, that is usually the right fit. Agency starts with keyword research across the whole service area and writes a page for every town-and-service pairing the research says is worth having, usually 30 to 60 pages, delivered in waves. We do not sell page counts, because thirty useful pages beat a hundred thin ones.

Agency, company or one builder?

Searches for a "web design agency Fort Lauderdale" or a "Fort Lauderdale web design company" turn up everything from large shops with account managers to freelancers. The right pick depends on what you need built.

Where we fit

A service business that needs clear pages, a working quote form, local SEO setup and someone who answers when you want a change. Every page written by hand, a demo before you pay, and the site is yours outright.

Where a development firm fits

Web development work such as a parts catalog with live inventory, a charter booking engine tied to your own calendar system, or a customer login portal. That is software, not a website, and it costs accordingly.

Appointment businesses, like a veterinary clinic, a dentist or a physical therapist, sit squarely in the first group. Their site needs services, a request form, insurance or payment notes and directions, and it needs to load fast on a phone.

Ask any firm you are weighing who owns the site when it is done, what a change costs after launch, and whether you can see a working draft before paying. Our answers: you do, $49 a month covers changes and hosting, and yes.

Broward help for small businesses

  • Florida SBDC at FAUFlorida Atlantic University hosts the Small Business Development Center office serving Broward and Palm Beach counties, with a Broward address on East Las Olas Boulevard. In 2021 it announced two branch offices in Davie, one at FAU's Davie West building and one at the Town of Davie's Community Services offices. It is part of the statewide Florida SBDC Network, whose lead host is the University of West Florida.
  • Broward County OESBDThe county's Office of Economic and Small Business Development certifies local firms that want county contracts. Its Small Business Enterprise program is for firms with 15 or fewer permanent full-time employees; applicants need a Broward business tax receipt, a location in the county and at least a year in operation.
  • Federal certificationsThe same office handles Disadvantaged Business Enterprise and Airport Concessions certification through the Florida Unified Certification Program.

If you are bidding on public work, the SBE or CBE status belongs on your site too, stated exactly as the certificate reads.

Common questions

How much does Fort Lauderdale website design cost for a small business?

Local quotes run from a few hundred dollars to well into five figures, and many firms will not give one until after a meeting. Ours are printed: Starter is $497, Pro is $997 and Agency is $1,997, each paid once. Hosting, maintenance and updates cost $49 a month, or nothing extra while you keep the AI agent. You see a free demo of your site before you decide.

Is there a good Fort Lauderdale web design company for a one-person marine business?

Look for one that will write about your actual work: the engines you service, the boat lengths you handle, the marinas you visit. A one-person detailer or mechanic does not need a big agency, just clear pages and a phone number that gets answered. We are one builder, Maurice Johnson, working remotely from East Texas, and we show you a demo first so you can judge the writing yourself.

Can you build an ecommerce site for my Fort Lauderdale shop?

Not inside these packages. Our sites are built to bring in calls, quote requests and visits, and an online store with a cart, shipping and inventory is not part of Starter, Pro or Agency. If you sell parts or gear online, tell us when you ask for the demo and we will say plainly whether a store platform is the better first step.

Will my site work on a phone at the dock?

Yes. Every site we build is responsive, which means the same pages rearrange to fit a phone, a tablet or a desktop. For marine work that matters, because the person searching is often standing on a dock or a deck with one bar of signal, so we keep pages light and put the call button where a thumb can reach it.

Do you do custom web design in Fort Lauderdale, or use templates?

Every page is written by hand for your business, never poured into a stock template. Agency adds custom design for your brand. What we do not do is custom software, such as a parts database or a booking engine tied to your own systems; that belongs with a development firm, and we will tell you so up front.

See your website before you pay for it

Give us your business name and what you do, and a demo site gets built for you to look at on your own phone. If you like it, pick a package. If you do not, you have spent nothing but the minute it took to look.
